description: Modifies the original Settings class provided by the user

derived_aem_pack_topic.description: Topic for events informing about derived AEMPacks.
derived_aem_pack_topic.title: Derived Aem Pack Topic

original_aem_pack_topic.description: Topic informing about new ingress AEMPacks.
original_aem_pack_topic.title: Original Aem Pack Topic

service_instance_id.description: A string that uniquely identifies this instance across all instances of this service. This is included in log messages.
service_instance_id.title: Service Instance Id

kafka_servers.description: A list of connection strings to connect to Kafka bootstrap servers.
kafka_servers.title: Kafka Servers

kafka_security_protocol.description: Protocol used to communicate with brokers. Valid values are: PLAINTEXT, SSL.
kafka_security_protocol.title: Kafka Security Protocol

kafka_ssl_cafile.description: Certificate Authority file path containing certificates used to sign broker certificates. If a CA is not specified, the default system CA will be used if found by OpenSSL.
kafka_ssl_cafile.title: Kafka Ssl Cafile

kafka_ssl_certfile.description: Optional filename of client certificate, as well as any CA certificates needed to establish the certificate's authenticity.
kafka_ssl_certfile.title: Kafka Ssl Certfile

kafka_ssl_keyfile.description: Optional filename containing the client private key.
kafka_ssl_keyfile.title: Kafka Ssl Keyfile

kafka_ssl_password.description: Optional password to be used for the client private key.
kafka_ssl_password.title: Kafka Ssl Password

generate_correlation_id.description: A flag, which, if False, will result in an error when trying to publish an event without a valid correlation ID set for the context. If True, a new correlation ID will be generated and used in the event header.
generate_correlation_id.title: Generate Correlation Id

kafka_max_message_size.description: The largest message size that can be transmitted, in bytes, before compression. Only services that have a need to send/receive larger messages should set this. When used alongside compression, this value can be set to something greater than the broker's `message.max.bytes` field, which effectively concerns the compressed message size.
kafka_max_message_size.title: Kafka Max Message Size

kafka_compression_type.description: The compression type used for messages. Valid values are: None, gzip, snappy, lz4, and zstd. If None, no compression is applied. This setting is only relevant for the producer and has no effect on the consumer. If set to a value, the producer will compress messages before sending them to the Kafka broker. If unsure, zstd provides a good balance between speed and compression ratio.
kafka_compression_type.title: Kafka Compression Type

kafka_max_retries.description: The maximum number of times to immediately retry consuming an event upon failure. Works independently of the dead letter queue.
kafka_max_retries.title: Kafka Max Retries

kafka_enable_dlq.description: A flag to toggle the dead letter queue. If set to False, the service will crash upon exhausting retries instead of publishing events to the DLQ. If set to True, the service will publish events to the DLQ topic after exhausting all retries
kafka_enable_dlq.title: Kafka Enable DLQ

kafka_dlq_topic.description: The name of the topic used to resolve error-causing events.
kafka_dlq_topic.title: Kafka DLQ Topic

kafka_retry_backoff.description: The number of seconds to wait before retrying a failed event. The backoff time is doubled for each retry attempt.
kafka_retry_backoff.title: Kafka Retry Backoff

mongo_dsn.description: MongoDB connection string. Might include credentials. For more information see: https://naiveskill.com/mongodb-connection-string/
mongo_dsn.title: Mongo Dsn

db_name.description: Name of the database located on the MongoDB server.
db_name.title: Db Name

mongo_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for API calls to MongoDB. The timeout applies to all steps needed to complete the operation, including server selection, connection checkout, serialization, and server-side execution. When the timeout expires, PyMongo raises a timeout exception. If set to None, the operation will not time out (default MongoDB behavior).
mongo_timeout.title: Mongo Timeout

log_level.description: The minimum log level to capture.
log_level.title: Log Level

log_format.description: If set, will replace JSON formatting with the specified string format. If not set, has no effect. In addition to the standard attributes, the following can also be specified: timestamp, service, instance, level, correlation_id, and details
log_format.title: Log Format

log_traceback.description: Whether to include exception tracebacks in log messages.
log_traceback.title: Log Traceback

processing_definition_path.description: Path to the config file used to populate the database with models, transformations and workflows.
processing_definition_path.title: Processing Definition Path

processing_poll_pause.description: Seconds to sleep when no unprocessed AEMPacks are found.
processing_poll_pause.title: Processing Poll Pause

worker_id.description: Unique identifier for a service instance used specifically for the reclamation logic.
worker_id.title: Worker Id

config_lock_expiry_seconds.description: TTL in seconds for the config lock document. MongoDB automatically removes stale locks after this duration.
config_lock_expiry_seconds.title: Config Lock Expiry Seconds

config_lock_poll_interval.description: Seconds between polls when waiting for the config lock to be released.
config_lock_poll_interval.title: Config Lock Poll Interval

config_lock_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the config lock to be released before raising a TimeoutError.
config_lock_timeout.title: Config Lock Timeout

title: ModSettings
